versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section with direct entry points for users coming from ClawHub.
- Removed redundant "skill-card.md" file; the skill now contains only SKILL.md.
- No changes to API or integration guidance—this is a documentation-only release.

Initial release of APIDot Chat API documentation skill.

- Provides guidance for chat API workflows with APIDot, including OpenAI-compatible chat completions, coding assistants, reasoning models, and multimodal routing.
- Contains only documentation—no scripts, API clients, or live requests.
- Details integration guidelines, model selection, API key security, and routing to APIDot docs and model pages.
- Includes official links for documentation, model catalog, quickstart, and support.
